about_the_game:
This DLC does not contain any content or unlocks, in-game or otherwise.

By purchasing this content, you will be making a donation to our charity partner, WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation, the leading charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. 95% of net publisher and developer revenue Secret Mode receives from these purchases will be donated to WDC.

WDC strives for a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free, and works globally through campaigns, lobbying, advising governments, conservation projects, field research, rescue, education and much more.
